title: Ordinary pullback comparison on good integral representatives
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite and h:U to T arbitrary. The composite of good-complex localization, ordinary derived pullback and detailed coefficient transport is naturally isomorphic to good-complex inclusion, strict ordinary pullback on complexes, exact detailed coefficient transport on complexes, and Q. For every good representative P the forward component is detailed transport of integralDerivedPullbackComparison at P, followed by pbcIntegralDetailedTransportFactors at the strict pullback of P. All functors and the two published comparison isomorphisms are those of [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data] and [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined].

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; Stacks 06YY. Ordinary good-model part of original strict-model matching descent step.

proof.text: Whisker the ordinary good-complex derived pullback comparison by detailed coefficient transport. Then whisker the exact coefficient comparison factorization by the strict ordinary pullback functor. Compose these isomorphisms, using explicit functor associators to match their endpoints. All associator components are identities, so their component formula is precisely the composite of the two published comparison maps.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_integral_good_model_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {U T : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ T) :
    ∃ e₀ : integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E T ⋙ integralDerivedPullback l E h ⋙
          integralDetailedTransport U l E ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E T).ι ⋙ integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E h ⋙
          pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      ∀ P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E T).FullSubcategory,
        e₀.hom.app P = (integralDetailedTransport U l E).map
            ((integralDerivedPullbackComparison l E h).hom.app P) ≫
          (pbcIntegralDetailedTransportFactors U l E).hom.app
            ((integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E h).obj P.obj)
